title: Places with no state income tax
blurb: Keep the pension whole. Every place on this list sits in a state that doesn't touch your income.

title: Places with explicit state protections
blurb: Every place here is in a state whose housing and public-accommodation laws name sexual orientation and gender identity explicitly.

title: Places under $400K
blurb: The median home costs less than $400,000 in every place on this list. Sunshine on a budget.

title: Walkable towns
blurb: Places where the errands, the coffee, and the friends are on foot.

title: Beach & coastal towns
blurb: Humidity, hurricane season, and a beach town's pace of life — every place here sits on the water.

title: Mountains & four seasons
blurb: Real winters, elevation or forest, and a slower pace built around the outdoors instead of nightlife.

title: Desert & big sky
blurb: Dry heat, wide streets, and sunbelt or resort-town living — snowbird energy, year-round.

title: Small town, everyone knows you
blurb: Population small enough that the whole town functions like one social circle.

title: Big-city amenities
blurb: A major airport, a full hospital system, and more than one option for everything — real-metro infrastructure.
